tasks.task: A dual-arm ARX X5 robot with the model as its policy, across the RoboDojo tasks (score 0–100 per task)
footnotes: Suite: the mean score 0–100 over all 10 tasks, a task the model was not run on counting as 0; validation start, best and curve are averaged the same way, and rounds are summed over the tasks. Curves stop at round 10; a longer run's last point is its final best. Per task, the model's latest run with a final test.

footnotes: Suite: the mean success rate over all 9 tasks, a task the model was not run on counting as 0; validation start, best and curve are averaged the same way, and rounds are summed over the tasks. Curves stop at round 10; a longer run's last point is its final best. Per task, the model's latest run with a final test.

† Muse Spark 1.3 through an internal endpoint, 5 rounds per task instead of 10; 5 of its 9 test evaluations ended in an error and show –. Shown for comparison: it takes no rank and is not counted in the overview.
